$comment: Pricing scaffold. Values live in config rather than code so they can change without a deploy, and so nothing on the scoring path can import them — packages/rubric has no dependency on this file and would fail to compile if it did. priceZar is a separate decision, not a conversion of priceUsd: nothing in the codebase applies an exchange rate, and a plan with no price in the currency somebody is buying in is refused rather than guessed at. The ZAR figures below are a placeholder awaiting Anré's sign-off — see docs/OPEN_ITEMS.md.

tiers.label: Free
tiers.contents: One limited report per app per 90 days. Headline score and top three findings. No evidence artefacts, no badge.

tiers.label: One-off deep report
tiers.contents: Full findings with evidence, remediation guide, improvement suggestions, store-readiness checklist, PDF export, one free re-test within 30 days.

tiers.label: Certified
tiers.contents: Badge, monthly re-assessment, drift alerts, trend history.

tiers.label: Agency
tiers.contents: Multi-app workspace, seats, white-label PDF export.

tiers.label: Organisation
tiers.contents: SSO, policy profiles, portfolio dashboard, audit export.

sponsorship.$comment: Advertising space on VibefyCode, per 30 days. One placement per surface at a time — the scarcity is the product, and the price follows from it: the app is quiet, and quiet is what makes a space on it worth paying for. Placeholder figures awaiting Anré’s sign-off, like the rand prices above.
